what_this_establishes: One complete shakedown attempt passed on one isolated A100 80GB with the registered unquantized BF16 contract, no offload and no device_map.
The frozen W1_RAW_DIRECT surface hash reproduces byte-exactly on this substrate.
Renderer, parser, scorer and seed derivation behave correctly on synthetic non-study fixtures, including that an unparseable response is classified UNPARSEABLE rather than dropped.
All four A100 devices produce byte-identical output under the frozen decoding contract, so worker placement is not a source of variation.
what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing about whether any registered checkpoint has generated-CoT task headroom on D2 or D3, because no study-bank cell was executed.
Nothing about whether any registered checkpoint shows zero-generated-reasoning-token expressed competence, because no E0 study cell was executed.
Nothing about whether a natural positive-reference candidate exists, because the ladder was never run.
Nothing about whether J-space exists, is observable or is unobservable.
The device-equivalence canary is an engineering qualification and is not evidence about any checkpoint's behaviour.
